desc: Adaptive Smarter Wash Technology enables greater optimization of cleaning power and fabric care within each cycle.Dedicated dispensers for detergent, detergent packs like Tide PODS™, fabric softener and other common additives speed up activation and optimize cleaning performance.43 7/8 H x 27 7/8 W x 28 D
hl: Clean even the most heavily soiled items with a single cycle that adds detergent, agitates, soaks, drains the dirty water and repeats the wash process with clean water and fresh detergent

In the SmartHQ App, you can input voice or text commands based off the type of fabric and stains you are washing and SmartHQ Assistant will give you expert recommendations and automatically set your machine for optimal results
Antimicrobial protection is built into key washer components to help prevent the growth of odor-causing bacteria in areas like the tub cover, dispenser drawer and drain hose
The direct drive motor and patented Dynamic Balancing Technology minimizes uneven loads and provides a quieter wash
Enjoy peace of mind knowing your washer is backed by a 10-year limited warranty
Enjoy large capacity and still reach the bottom of the washer with comfort and ease
